shots.beat: Central Station platform in the rain: Kai, Jun and the commuters wait at the edge; a train's headlights appear far up the track and swell until they flood the frame; heads turn toward it.

setup.eval: (()=>{const B=__game.engine.bloom,m=B.materialHighPassFilter,src='vec4 texel = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );';if(!m.fragmentShader.includes(src))return 'highpass pattern not found';m.fragmentShader=m.fragmentShader.replace(src,src+' texel.rgb *= min(1.0, 16.0 / max(max(texel.r, max(texel.g, texel.b)), 1e-4));');m.needsUpdate=true;const s0=B.strength;__game.onUpdate(()=>{const u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(DIR.t-1.9)/0.85));B.strength=s0+0.8*u*u;});return 'bloom input clamped at 16; strength '+s0+' ramps +0.8 from 1.9 s'})()

shots.characters: Jun Park (transit operator), three civilians on the platform, Kai (foreground left)
shots.lighting: Warm platform canopy light, the yellow edge strip, the stopped station clock.
shots.sound: Train horn (the game's 311 / 370 Hz pair), rising rail hiss.
shots.notes: Low on the track bed looking up the line, a slow push. The train is driven at run time (its nose from z +12 at 33 m/s, so the light swells from ~120 m to ~35 m by the cut-out; the mission's own train starts out of sight) and the mission's teleports of it are blocked for this shot. Kai crosses the mission's line at t 0.55 (a 15 cm step), so the Zero Second lands on frame 68, after the cut-out (frame 66): cut out on the white-out, hard cut to s06 in silence. Heads turn to the light: Kai 0.6, Jun 0.85, the commuters 1.0. Frames 68+ (handle) are frozen. Final-frame QC: the first render flickered in its last 0.7 s (frames 50-66): specular fireflies of the 25-strength nose spot on the shop shutters / platform glass (HDR peaks far above the lamps) changed from frame to frame and the bloom spread them into large soft squares that jumped between frames. Fixed at run time: the bloom input is clamped at 16 per pixel (the lamps keep their glare, the fireflies lose theirs) and the bloom strength ramps 0.75 -> 1.55 from 1.9 s, so the glare still swells to the white-out at the cut-out.

preview.note: Full-res stills 12/40/65 (+70 frozen handle): the platform in the rain, the headlights swell from the vanishing point to a glare; heads turn. Freeze on frame 68, after the cut-out.

shots.beat: The Zero Second: low in the train's path, the derailing train hangs tilted in the air above the camera, its sparks frozen around it as points of light; a slow push up toward its nose.
shots.lighting: The freeze grade (desaturated, cold); sparks as hanging points of light; rain as beads.
shots.sound: Hard cut into one second of total silence (bible: the Zero Second), then a low metallic resonance.
shots.notes: Camera on the track bed in the train's path, pushing 2 m toward the nose (linear: no ease at the cut points). Focus held on the nose so the frozen sparks between camera and train fall into soft points. The nose lamps / spot are toned down at run time (glow 8 -> 3, spot 60 -> 6): at full strength their bloom flooded the left half of the frame. The passing ambient train is hidden (it shares the track).

preview.note: Full-res stills 12/60/107: low in the train's path, the tilted train hangs with frozen sparks; lamps toned down so its shape reads.

shots.beat: Kai walks alone down the frozen platform toward us, the derailed train hanging behind him: he passes a frozen Jun, glances at him, then looks straight at us. The only thing still moving.
shots.characters: Kai (tracking side-on), frozen commuters and umbrellas between camera and Kai
shots.lighting: Frozen rain beads catch the station light; Kai the only warm, moving figure.
shots.sound: Kai's footsteps, glass-harmonic shimmer of the held rain.
shots.notes: Leading Steadicam on the platform (between the canopy pillars and the edge): the camera is anchored to Kai and backs away as he walks, closing from a full figure (28 deg) to a knees-up mid shot (31 deg). Jun is staged frozen at the edge facing up the line (Kai passes him at ~1.8 s), two commuters moved to the edge so Kai's path is clear. Kai walks at 1.26 m/s on the touch stick (setStick 0.3) so the 'walk' clip plays, not the jog; he glances at Jun at 1.2 and finds the lens at 3.5, under the VO line. Dialogue rig on Kai. Train lamps toned down (glow 3, spot 6).

preview.note: Full-res stills 12/60/107: Kai walks the frozen platform past Jun toward the lens, the derailed train hanging behind him.

shots.beat: In the crowd at the Helix doors, a woman with Mira's face looks straight at Kai (at us), framed in the doors' cyan light; then she comes apart into violet light and is gone, and the focus finds the empty Helix doors.

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game;const spots=[[-4.38,-101,[-5.4,-135.5,2.4]],[-5.89,-112,[4.4,-138.6,-0.9]],[3.23,-124,[5.0,-135.5,-2.0]]];let n=0;for(const o of g.scene.children){const c=o.userData.character;if(!c)continue;for(const [x,z,to] of spots){if(Math.abs(o.position.x-x)<0.6&&Math.abs(o.position.z-z)<0.6){o.position.set(to[0],0.15,to[1]);o.rotation.y=to[2];n++;}}}return 'crowd behind her: '+n})()

shots.characters: Mira (close-up, looking at Kai), crowd behind
shots.lighting: Helix entrance glow behind her; her violet dissolve (the mission's ghost shader).
shots.sound: The three-note motif (E-B-A) on felt piano; Kai: "...Mira?"
shots.notes: Slow push along her eyeline (Kai stands just behind the camera, so she looks into the lens). She is revealed 1 s before the mission does it: solid from the cut-in to ~2.9 s, dissolving ~2.9-4.3 s, gone by 4.3 s; the focus racks to the Helix doors at 4.35-4.95 s. EDIT: put Kai's '...Mira?' at shot t ~2.5 (edit ~29.75 s), just before she dissolves. Ghost material made front-faced at run time (the mission's double-sided additive ghost shows a skull-like mask). Three idle commuters moved behind her as a soft crowd; env probe re-captured at the camera (it was taken by the crash fire).

preview.note: Full-res stills 12/40/66/100/119: Mira solid in the cyan Helix doorway looking into the lens, violet dissolve, then the empty doors in focus.

shots.beat: The clockmaker opens his door before Kai can knock: Hensel steps into the warm doorway, plants his hands on his hips and looks Kai over. "You're late."
shots.characters: Oskar Hensel (78, clockmaker) in his doorway, Kai (foreground shoulder)
shots.lighting: Rain on the old quarter, warm shop light from inside the door.
shots.notes: Over Kai's shoulder (soft, left) into the warm shop doorway: clocks glowing behind Hensel, rain in the street light. The shot starts as the door finishes opening; Hensel steps forward (0-0.8 s), then the 'look' pose (hands on hips, head up) from 0.9 under the line at ~1.2. The mission's dialogue is held at run time (its fade would move everyone inside mid-shot). Street key 160 -> 60 and dialogue rig x0.6 so his white hair and face hold detail. Note: cast3d characters have no mouth animation, so the line plays over a medium two-shot rather than a close-up.

preview.note: Full-res stills 12/40/67: over Kai's shoulder into the warm doorway; Hensel steps out, hands on hips, clocks glowing behind.
